title: leiboldia serrata
intro: Leiboldia serrata, commonly known as  Kutki or Kurchi, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family and is also known as Leptadenia reticulata. It has been used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Leiboldia serrata include its potential to aid in digestive disorders, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides that have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective properties.
